title: Enable the pilot skill in development stage on Ryan's Echo devices and record evidence
description: Turn the plugin on for Pilobolus, deploy, and test on the developer account's devices: launch, read, help, stop, fallback. Record transcripts and screenshots on this epic.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: the Pilobolus skill (amzn1.ask.skill.33751759-…) is live in development stage. Ryan reached it on his Echo/simulator with 'open pilobolus newsroom'. The skill answered every intent in a direct Lambda test. Under Alexa+, a one-word invocation name ('pilobolus') is taken as a media request, so the name becomes 'pilobolus newsroom' (Ryan, 2026-10-31).
